purpose: Convert the riskiest AI/data-center case from broad source aggregation into project-instrument blockers and evidence now bound.

matrix.evidence_now_bound: Official standard requiring load characteristics, upgrade identification, customer-caused cost assignment, stranded-risk protections, local/environmental impact review, and ongoing reporting.
matrix.still_missing: Binding order/tariff/service agreement applying the standard to River Bend and actual compliance records.
matrix.case_effect: Provides the test project instruments must pass; does not certify compliance.

matrix.evidence_now_bound: Order-level conditions for cost recovery, ESA nonapproval boundary, guarantees/security, customer-caused upgrades, and quarterly public reporting.
matrix.still_missing: Implementation filings and evidence that analogous protections are present for River Bend.
matrix.case_effect: Creates a Louisiana comparator for project-level cost-assignment discipline.

matrix.evidence_now_bound: Official parish page lists the May 4, 2026 IDB resolution route and identifies the IDB board.
matrix.still_missing: PDF body, signed resolution, meeting minutes, exhibits, lease, and cooperative endeavor agreement.
matrix.case_effect: Moves missing-instrument work from vague public-record search to a named route and document.

matrix.evidence_now_bound: Reported special-meeting approval of $10M advance; reported $5.3M/$3.9M/$0.8M allocation; reported repayment from first regular PILOT payment; earlier WBRZ distribution schedule reporting.
matrix.still_missing: Executed CEA, proof of July 1 payment, recipient accounting, budget amendments, and final spending.
matrix.case_effect: Material progress on public-upside implementation, but still not primary proof.

matrix.evidence_now_bound: Official legislature page reports signed Act 434 and January 1, 2027 effective date.
matrix.still_missing: 2027 local meeting, unanimous rebate vote, final tax-bill credits, and household incidence.
matrix.case_effect: Turns rebate from proposal into a 2027 implementation watch item.

matrix.evidence_now_bound: Company/local reporting claims $16M water investment, transfer to parish, closed-loop cooling, and local supply protections.
matrix.still_missing: Signed water agreement, permits, engineering/hydrology, asset acceptance, O&M cost assignment, and operating data.
matrix.case_effect: Narrows water risk to verifyable documents and operating metrics.

matrix.evidence_now_bound: Local reporting states first-phase switchyard/lines are not expected to fall on taxpayers or rate base.
matrix.case_effect: This is the decisive ratepayer-cost premise; it remains unverified until utility accounting is bound.

matrix.evidence_now_bound: Statutory data-center exemption route and local reporting that sales-tax benefits make gross local revenue hard to estimate.
matrix.still_missing: LED certification, Department of Revenue records, exemption value, clawback terms, and net present value against PILOT flows.
matrix.case_effect: Prevents treating gross PILOT as pure public upside.

bottom_line: Rev0360 makes real progress on River Bend implementation proof, especially the public-record route and reported $10M advance. The case remains not_certified_current because decisive signed instruments, utility accounting, water permits, incentive quantification, and actual payment/spending records are still missing. Rev0374 keeps this matrix current as a noncertifying historical blocker map.
